lineage.description: Aridity index (AI) values were calculated from long-term climate data to create a spatiotemporally continuous raster dataset representing drought status across Somalia. The AI metric integrates precipitation and temperature patterns to provide an effective estimator of meteorological drought conditions for national-scale drought assessment and monitoring applications.
